'''Outpost Shadowstrike''' was an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] military outpost on [[Voss]], in the [[Old Paths]]. Under the direction of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Evran]], [[Havoc Squad]] attacked the outpost to find and capture the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Deadfall]].
